page.title: Review queue
page.subtitle: Two-hand review: you solve each item blind first, then critique it. If your answer and the author’s key disagree, the item is rejected.

queue.title: Queue
queue.label: Items to review
queue.payTitle: Authors are paid per accepted item
queue.payBody: Not per submitted item. Your verdict decides the payment, so the key stays hidden until you have answered.

solve.hint: The author’s key and rationales are hidden. Choose the answer you believe is correct.
solve.revealHint: Once the key is revealed, your answer is locked in.
solve.decidedOther: Another reviewer has already given a verdict on this version. Move on to the next item.

reveal.checkFmt: Does every distractor match a real misconception rather than filling a slot? The author expects {p}% of grade {g} to solve it — does that feel right? Do the Uzbek and Russian versions ask exactly the same thing?
reveal.checkNoP: Does every distractor match a real misconception rather than filling a slot? Do the Uzbek and Russian versions ask exactly the same thing?

dis.title: Answers disagree — this item is rejected automatically
dis.body: You chose {you}; the author’s key is {key}. In two-hand review any disagreement on the answer means rejection: either the item can be read two ways or the key is wrong. {author} will see both answers and can submit a new version.

verdict.label: Verdict
verdict.acceptSub: Goes to pretesting. The author is paid.
verdict.reviseSub: Back to the author. The fix becomes a new version.
verdict.rejectSub: Unusable. The author isn’t paid for it.
verdict.notesPh: What exactly should change, and why?
verdict.notesErr: Add a note: the author needs to know what to fix.
verdict.submitReady: After you submit, the next item in the queue opens.

done.title: Already reviewed
done.body: Verdict: {v}. Verdicts are final — the author responds with a new version, which comes back to this queue.

toast.accept: {code} accepted. {author} will be paid for it.
toast.revise: {code} returned to {author} for revision. The fix will come back as a new version.
toast.reject: {code} rejected. No payment for this item.
toast.match: Your answer matches the author’s key. Now give your verdict.

states.emptyBody: Every submitted item has a verdict. New items appear here as soon as an author submits them.
states.errTitle: We couldn’t load the review queue
states.errBody: Verdicts you have already submitted are saved. Try again in a moment.
states.noAccessTitle: You don’t have access to this section
states.noAccessBody: The review queue is for item reviewers only. Ask an administrator if you need access.
states.itemErrBody: The item bank didn’t respond. Try again, or pick another item from the queue.
states.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date. Pick an item from the queue.
states.unavailableBody: Either it is your own item (nobody reviews their own), or it is no longer in review.

errors.own_item: You can’t review your own item.
errors.not_in_review: This item is no longer in review.
errors.decided: This version already has a verdict.
errors.already_solved: You have already solved this item — the page was refreshed.
errors.disagreed: The answers disagreed, so the item was rejected automatically.
errors.note_required: Add a note: the author needs to know what to fix.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Item not found. The page was refreshed.
errors.OPTION_NOT_FOUND: That option wasn’t found. Refresh the page.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don’t have permission to do that.
errors.NETWORK: The connection dropped. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
